summary: All research questions are explained, so this turn records the final source-level link in the StopSign-resync account without another execution. The open question was how a leader can hold a prepare quorum yet lack a StopSign that an accept quorum already contains. handle_majority_promises merges only the single max_promise_sync kept while promises arrive in the Prepare phase, and handle_promise_accept, used once the leader is in Phase::Accept, only records the promise and answers it with an AcceptSync; it never merges that Promise's log_sync. A follower that accepted the StopSign and then promises late therefore never hands the StopSign to the leader, yet its accepted index still appears in later Accepted replies and is counted by is_chosen toward the leader's decision. This closes the chain behind the run-13 receipt: leader 4 lacked the StopSign, so its AcceptSync to node 3 ended at 37, while a late-promising StopSign holder's Accepted reply could still make index 38 chosen and produce the two sequence-expected Decides that clamped at 37. The update adds two sources (handle_promise_accept and handle_majority_promises), the behavior record, and links it to the question. No execution is requested.
